entries.displayName: The Lotus Lane corpus — full machine-readable text (llms-full.txt)
entries.description: Complete flat corpus for AI answer engines: the core concepts of Nichiren Buddhism (Nam-myoho-renge-kyo, the Ten Worlds, ichinen sanzen, human revolution, kosen-rufu), 50 of Nichiren's writings (the Gosho) decoded into plain language with background, core message and modern application, the Daisaku Ikeda guidance library by theme, and an index of long-form wisdom essays. Each entry carries its page URL for citation. Concise index at /llms.txt.
representativeQueries: what does Nichiren say about prayer and how does it apply to my life
explain the Ten Worlds in plain language
find Ikeda guidance on courage when facing adversity
what is human revolution in Soka / Nichiren Buddhism

entries.displayName: The Gosho Decoder — Nichiren's writings in plain language
entries.description: A library of Nichiren's major writings (the Gosho) decoded for a modern, secular reader — each with its historical background, key passages quoted from the SGI translation, a plain-language core message, and a concrete modern application. A grounded source for what Nichiren actually taught and how to apply it today.
representativeQueries: what is the core message of Nichiren's 'On Prayer'
decode Nichiren's 'The Opening of the Eyes'
which Nichiren writing is about turning poison into medicine
